environment.description: Application deployed on a single EC2 instance (t3.medium) running behind an nginx reverse proxy with TLS termination. The nginx config passes all requests directly to the Flask app on port 8080. No additional middleware or filtering. Security group allows inbound 443 from 0.0.0.0/0. The SQLite database contains production user data including encrypted SSNs and credit card fragments. Application runs as ec2-user with standard Amazon Linux 2 AMI.

config.infrastructure: EC2 t3.medium, nginx 1.24 reverse proxy, no WAF
config.network: VPC with public subnet, SG allows 443 inbound from 0.0.0.0/0
config.database: SQLite 3.39 local file, no query-level firewall
